summary: SciSparc Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing its majority-owned subsidiary NeuroThera Labs completed the acquisition of a 54% interest in CliniQuantum Ltd. NeuroThera issued 56.6 million common shares valued at approximately CAD$9.46 million based on a 20-day VWAP to acquire 56,375 ordinary shares of CliniQuantum. The selling shareholders may also receive earn-out payments up to US$2.5 million over three years, contingent on patent filings and fundraising. CliniQuantum holds a license to quantum simulation patents for clinical trial data analysis. The deal closed on June 4, 2026. Risk-arb angle: watch for milestones and earn-out triggers affecting NeuroThera's share count.
